q: The ε-smooth min-entropy Hmin^ε(ρ) is defined by:
opts: Hmin^ε(ρ) = max_{ρ̃: ‖ρ̃-ρ‖₁≤ε} Hmin(ρ̃) (smoothing allows 'cheating' on ε fraction of probability)
Hmin^ε(ρ) = H_ε(ρ) (Rényi entropy at order ε)
exp: Smooth entropy (Renner 2005): Hmin^ε(ρ) = max over all ρ̃ within ε in trace distance of Hmin(ρ̃). The smoothing allows ignoring ε-fraction of probability mass — making the entropy larger (smoother = less pessimistic). In the i.i.d. limit, Hmin^ε/n → S(ρ).
